title: Dream about lava
content: So, I'm pretty sure I'm a dream traveler as I assume most of you are. I had a dream once when I was a kid about lava roaming through the streets of my suburb, it was very bright and thick. I remember I was hiding in one of my neighbors porch. It was nighttime and everyone had to be inside their homes with the lights turned off. Apparently, we had to hide from this "lava". I wonder if anyone else has had a similar dream. I tried to have AI generate an image, but nothing was accurate enough.
